DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-Induced Akathisia (likely secondary to Risperidone).

Your description of an inability to remain still, fidgeting, and pacing is highly characteristic of akathisia, a common side effect of antipsychotics like risperidone. Given your recent start on this medication and improvement in psychotic symptoms, this is the most likely cause.
